Subject: Thornbury Warehousing Submission - Referral Questions

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the Thornbury Warehousing submission. I've reviewed the information and have a few questions before I can move forward.

I'm seeing five-year incurred losses above $250K in the loss runs. To properly evaluate this risk, I need to understand:

- What were the causes of the major losses?
- What corrective actions has the insured implemented since these losses occurred?
- Are there any outstanding claims or reserves?

Depending on your answers, this may fall outside our standard appetite due to the loss history. If that's the case, I'd recommend reaching out to a surplus lines market that specializes in higher-hazard warehousing risks.

Happy to discuss further if helpful.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
